# A gen.exec call says what it needs -- the prefix its command begins with and
# the flags it bans -- and the compiler holds every call to both, granted or
# not. A command that is safe can still be handed an argument that is not, so
# the prompt shows exactly what was declared and a grant covers no more.
env SNGL_GENCACHE=off

# The declared prefix, granted: runs.
sngl generate --lang=none --platform=html -o out --allow-command='./pc=sh -c' ok.sngl
grep 'said: ok' out/index.html

# A grant broader than the declared prefix covers it; a narrower one does not.
sngl generate --lang=none --platform=html -o out --allow-command='./pc=sh' ok.sngl
! sngl generate --lang=none --platform=html -o out --allow-command='./pc=sh -c echo' ok.sngl
stderr 'may not run sh -c ''echo ok'': running it needs --allow-command="\./pc=sh -c"'

# A command that does not begin with what the call declared is the plugin's
# own error, whatever was granted.
! sngl generate --lang=none --platform=html -o out --allow-all prefix.sngl
stderr 'gen.exec: \[sh -c ''echo no''\] does not begin with its declared prefix \[bash\]'

# A banned flag is refused in every spelling, granted or not.
! sngl generate --lang=none --platform=html -o out --allow-all ban1.sngl
stderr 'gen.exec: argument "-toolexec" is a flag the call bans \(-toolexec\)'
! sngl generate --lang=none --platform=html -o out --allow-all ban2.sngl
stderr 'gen.exec: argument "--toolexec" is a flag the call bans \(-toolexec\)'
! sngl generate --lang=none --platform=html -o out --allow-all ban3.sngl
stderr 'gen.exec: argument "-toolexec=x" is a flag the call bans \(-toolexec\)'
! sngl generate --lang=none --platform=html -o out --allow-all ban4.sngl
stderr 'gen.exec: argument "--toolexec=x" is a flag the call bans \(-toolexec\)'

# A ban written with two dashes bans the one-dash spelling too.
! sngl generate --lang=none --platform=html -o out --allow-all ban5.sngl
stderr 'gen.exec: argument "-overlay" is a flag the call bans \(--overlay\)'

# A flag that merely begins like a banned one is not it.
sngl generate --lang=none --platform=html -o out --allow-all near.sngl
grep 'said: -toolexecutor' out/index.html

-- ok.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"
import pc "./pc"

const v = pc.run(["sh", "-c", "echo ok"], ["sh", "-c"], [])

ui.window(title="t") {
    ui.text(value="said: {v}")
}
-- prefix.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"
import pc "./pc"

const v = pc.run(["sh", "-c", "echo no"], ["bash"], [])

ui.window(title="t") {
    ui.text(value="said: {v}")
}
-- ban1.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"
import pc "./pc"

const v = pc.run(["sh", "-c", "echo $0", "-toolexec"], ["sh"], ["-toolexec"])

ui.window(title="t") {
    ui.text(value="said: {v}")
}
-- ban2.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"
import pc "./pc"

const v = pc.run(["sh", "-c", "echo $0", "--toolexec"], ["sh"], ["-toolexec"])

ui.window(title="t") {
    ui.text(value="said: {v}")
}
-- ban3.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"
import pc "./pc"

const v = pc.run(["sh", "-c", "echo $0", "-toolexec=x"], ["sh"], ["-toolexec"])

ui.window(title="t") {
    ui.text(value="said: {v}")
}
-- ban4.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"
import pc "./pc"

const v = pc.run(["sh", "-c", "echo $0", "--toolexec=x"], ["sh"], ["-toolexec"])

ui.window(title="t") {
    ui.text(value="said: {v}")
}
-- ban5.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"
import pc "./pc"

const v = pc.run(["sh", "-c", "echo $0", "-overlay"], ["sh"], ["--overlay"])

ui.window(title="t") {
    ui.text(value="said: {v}")
}
-- near.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"
import pc "./pc"

const v = pc.run(["sh", "-c", "echo $0", "-toolexecutor"], ["sh"], ["-toolexec"])

ui.window(title="t") {
    ui.text(value="said: {v}")
}
-- pc/pc.sngl --
import gen "sngl:x/gen"

// Runs cmd, declaring prefix and banFlags, and returns what it printed.
const func run(cmd list<string>, prefix list<string>, banFlags list<string>) string {
    var out = ""
    var p = gen.exec(cmd=cmd, prefix=prefix, banFlags=banFlags)
    for var line = p.stdout {
        out = out + line
    }
    return out
}
